name: Default
shortDescription: Self-hosted drone flight log analyzer for DJI, Litchi and other logs, with maps, telemetry charts, tags, exports and password-protected profiles.

alerts.message: The default profile is locked on first start with the generated DEFAULT_PROFILE_PASSWORD, and creating or deleting profiles asks for PROFILE_CREATION_PASS. Copy both from the environment variables. Changing DEFAULT_PROFILE_PASSWORD later has no effect; change it in Settings instead.
